message.content: {"note_claim": "The ship was flying a false flag, so the French navy had the right to board it under international law.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "La Marine française a estimé qu’il s’agissait probablement d’un faux pavillon, et a décidé de monter à bord du navire, comme le permet la convention de Montego Bay sur le droit de la mer.", "reason": "The article reports the tanker was suspected of flying a false flag and that boarding is permitted under the Montego Bay (UNCLOS) convention, substantiating the note's claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The ship was flying a false flag, so the French navy had the right to board it under international law.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: La Marine française a estimé qu’il s’agissait probablement d’un faux pavillon, et a décidé de monter à bord du navire, comme le permet la convention de Montego Bay sur le droit de la mer.
parsed.reason: The article reports the tanker was suspected of flying a false flag and that boarding is permitted under the Montego Bay (UNCLOS) convention, substantiating the note's claim.
